name: How My Friend Group Exploded
source:
One day everything's normal, the next I find out my friend's in love with me. Fallout, of course, ensues.

Nat is struggling to connect with her friend group and when a secret is revealed things start to go south quickly. Does this reveal change the way she feels about one of her friends? Is it just your average teenage drama? Does it go deeper than that? And most important of all, does Nat even have the mental space to figure any of that out when she has her own issues? 

[From [url=https://dinosourkisses.itch.io/how-my-friend-group-exploded]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天一切都很正常，第二天我发现我的朋友爱上了我。当然，后果随之而来。

纳特正在努力与她的朋友圈建立联系，当一个秘密被揭露时，事情开始迅速恶化。这一揭露是否会改变她对一位朋友的感觉？这只是普通的青少年戏剧吗？它还有比这更深的吗？最重要的是，当Nat遇到自己的问题时，她是否有足够的心理空间来解决这些问题？

[来自[url=https://dinosourkisses.itch.io/how-my-friend-group-exploded]Itch.io[/url]]
